The Pleiades (M45) - S50 Pro, 70min (60s subs), Bortle 4 These are the famous "Seven Sisters" of our night sky and they carry with them one of the oldest and most fascinating legends in history. According to Greek mythology, they were the daughters of the Titan Atlas and the nymph Pleione. When Zeus condemned Atlas to eternally bear the weight of the heavens upon his shoulders, his daughters were left defenseless. The giant hunter Orion became infatuated with them and began pursuing them relentlessly for seven long years. In despair, the sisters pleaded with the gods for help. Moved by pity, Zeus first transformed them into doves so they could escape capture, and then turned them into stars, setting them within the constellation Taurus. Yet celestial mechanics made this pursuit eternal: upon his death, Orion was also turned into a constellation and placed in the sky right behind the cluster. The 14th Culture and Art Festival of Countries in the Lancang-Mekong River Basin opened on Oct 28 in Jinghong City, Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture, China's Yunnan Province. On the evening of Oct 28, the opening ceremony gala was held in Jinghong City, where the audience immersed themselves in the unique charm of diverse civilizations in the Lancang-Mekong region blending and thriving together. During the festival, a series of events will also be held, including the Xishuangbanna international image exhibition, and the Lancang-Mekong treasures carnival.
